solves: Gives the person a field that opens a closed list of options to pick one, and takes part in the form that contains it.
use_when: When the person picks a single option from a closed list of 6 to 15 items.
Inside an nph-field, which gives the label, the help text and the error message.
With start=avatar when the options are people, and start=icon when a symbol helps recognize the option.
default in general use; large on the screen that needs the 44 px target, for every field of the form.
do_not_use_when: For 2 to 5 options: use nph-radio, so the person sees all of them without opening anything.
For more than 15 options, or when the person needs to search: use nph-combobox.
To pick several options: use nph-multi-combobox.
To name the field with the placeholder alone: it is replaced by the choice.
With the magnifying glass at the start: search belongs to nph-combobox.

size.constraint: The height of the trigger and the width of the arrow area: control/height-default or control/height-large. Reflects because the internal CSS selects the height by it. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

value.constraint: The current value. The value attribute is the initial value and the value of form.reset(), as in nph-input (P80). The chosen option is the first nph-option with that value; the value is kept until such an option arrives. Setting it from code fires no event.

placeholder.constraint: The invitation before a choice, already localized, such as "Select an option". It is not a name: the choice replaces it.

start.constraint: The start of the trigger. icon: the icon of the chosen option when its own start is icon, otherwise the icon property. avatar: the photo of the chosen option when its own start is avatar, otherwise the empty avatar (D4). The dot of an option never goes to the trigger. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

icon.constraint: A core name of nph-icon: the start icon with start=icon before a choice, or when the chosen option has no icon. magnifying-glass renders and warns in development: search belongs to nph-combobox. Any name outside the core draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

open.constraint: The list is open. The piece opens and closes it; the consumer may set it. Opening and closing fire no event. A disabled select, or one with no option to choose, does not open.

name.constraint: The name of the entry in the form data. Reflects because the form reads the attribute of the host. With no chosen option, the entry is left out.

required.constraint: With no choice, or with a chosen option of empty value, the piece is valueMissing, with the message of the browser. nph-field writes it. A form whose messages are written by nph-field uses novalidate when the browser balloon is not wanted.

disabled.constraint: The whole piece at state/disabled-opacity, on color/muted, out of the Tab order and of the form data; the list does not open. A disabled fieldset disables it too. It wins over invalid.

invalid.constraint: The error state: the border becomes status/error and the trigger gets aria-invalid. It is not a constraint of the form. The sentence belongs to nph-field; never invalid without it.

label.constraint: The accessible name in text, never visible, for a select with no associated label; nph-field writes it. An associated label (a label element with for) wins over it.

description.constraint: The accessible description in text, never visible: the help or the error sentence that nph-field writes.

slot.constraint: The options: nph-option children, as option children of a select. The list shows them in order.

input.constraint: Fired by the host when the person chooses an option of a different value. It bubbles and crosses shadow roots. Read the value from the host.

change.constraint: Fired by the host right after input. It bubbles. Setting value or open from code fires neither event.

size.choose_when: default in general use; large on the screen that needs the 44 px target for the accessibility of its users. One size per form, the same as the button next to the field.
do_not_combine_with: default and large fields in the same form.

start.choose_when: avatar when the options are people; icon when a symbol helps recognize the option; none in every other case. The trigger repeats the start of the chosen option.
do_not_combine_with: Options with and without a start in the same list.
The magnifying glass as the start icon.

default.changes_for_user: The resting border, on color/background, with the arrow area in color/accent.

hover.changes_for_user: The border goes one step darker under the pointer.

focus.changes_for_user: Keyboard focus: the border takes focus/border with the focus/halo attached outside, at focus/radius-control.

open.changes_for_user: The focus look with the list open below the trigger and the arrow up (chevron-up).

error.changes_for_user: The border is status/error, also on hover; the sentence is in nph-field.

error-focus.changes_for_user: The border stays status/error and the halo is focus/halo-error.

disabled.changes_for_user: The whole piece at state/disabled-opacity on color/muted, with the color/input border; it does not open and wins over the error.

business_rules: The person chooses by a click on an option, or by Enter, Space or Alt+ArrowUp on the active option; the list closes and the focus stays on the trigger.
A choice of a different value fires input and then change; choosing the option already chosen, Escape, Tab, a click outside and code fire nothing.
Tab closes the list without choosing, and the focus moves on.
Enter opens and chooses; it does not submit the form.
Disabled options are skipped by the keyboard and cannot be chosen.
disabled wins over invalid: no error look on a field the person cannot change.
domain_errors: invalid: the choice needs correction, such as a required field with no choice; nph-field writes the sentence and passes it as description.

tokens.border: border/width, in color/input, color/input-hover, focus/border or status/error
tokens.padding: space/control-padding on the left; 0 on the right
tokens.start: nph-icon icon/size-sm in color/muted-foreground, or nph-avatar sm
tokens.arrow_area: color/accent, control/height-* wide, radius/none on the left and radius/control-inner on the right; the arrow icon/size-sm in color/muted-foreground
tokens.list: color/popover, border/width in color/input, radius/container, elevation/dropdown, padding space/inline-tight, maximum height layout/max-list-height
tokens.focus: focus/border, focus/halo, focus/halo-error, focus/ring-width and focus/radius-control

ai_hints: Use nph-select for one choice among 6 to 15 options; for 2 to 5, nph-radio; for more than 15 or with search, nph-combobox; for several, nph-multi-combobox.
Put nph-select inside nph-field, which gives the label, the help text and the error message.
Write the options as nph-option children, one start for the whole list.
Never use the placeholder as the only name.
To show an error, set the error of nph-field; do not set invalid on the select alone.
Read the value from the host on input or change; do not listen for an nph-* event or for the opening of the list.
Use the same size for every field and the button of one form.

accessibility.semantics: A select-only combobox (APG): the trigger has role combobox, aria-haspopup listbox, aria-expanded and aria-controls; the list has role listbox and the options role option. The host is form-associated and labelable.
accessibility.accessible_name: From the label associated with the host, which the trigger and the list reference. Without one, from label. The placeholder is not a name. With no name at all, the select renders and warns in development.
keyboard: Closed: Enter, Space, ArrowDown, ArrowUp and Alt+ArrowDown open the list on the chosen option, or on the first one; Home and End open it on the first and the last; a printable character opens it on the option that starts with it.
Open: ArrowDown and ArrowUp move without wrapping; Home, End, PageUp and PageDown jump; typing moves to the option that starts with the typed text.
Open: Enter, Space and Alt+ArrowUp choose the active option and close; Escape closes without choosing; Tab closes without choosing and the focus moves on.
accessibility.focus: The focus stays on the trigger; the active option is pointed to by aria-activedescendant. The trigger shows the focus border and the halo for the keyboard and while the list is open.
accessibility.contrast: The text of the trigger and of the option meets 4.5:1 and the border of the trigger meets 3:1, in light and dark mode; the arrow keeps 3:1 on color/accent; the check on color/primary-surface measures 4.78:1 and 6.26:1 (D8). The disabled state is exempt.
accessibility.color_alternative: The error is said by the sentence of nph-field; the selected option has a background and the check; the dot goes with the written state; the arrow turns up when the list opens.

invalid_combinations: A size outside default and large — the select draws nothing.
A start outside none, icon and avatar — the select draws nothing.
An icon outside the core names — the select draws nothing.
invalid without the sentence in nph-field — red with no text.
anti_patterns: Using it with more than 15 options, or when the person needs to search.
Putting a checkbox on the option.
Using the magnifying glass at the start.
Mixing options with and without a start in the same list.
Changing the color of the arrow area: for an error, use invalid.
Using the status dot without a written state.
